_comment: 复制到 ~/.config/vibegauge/plans.json。国内这些订阅制 Coding Plan 都不给公开的用量接口，而且厂商明确禁止用「非 AI 编程工具」去调它的端点（会被判滥用，可能停订阅甚至封号），所以 VibeGauge 既不探测也不猜：额度 = 经本机记账代理的请求数 ÷ 你填的上限，面板上一律标「估算」。走代理之外的调用（别的机器、别的工具）不会被算进来，估算会偏低。
_comment_en: Copy to ~/.config/vibegauge/plans.json. Subscription coding plans that offer no usage API (and forbid probing their endpoints from non-coding tools) are estimated, never probed: quota = requests counted by the local accounting proxy / the limit you enter here, always labelled 'estimated'. Calls that bypass the proxy are not counted, so the estimate runs low. Key = upstream name shown in the panel (the provider field in api-calls.jsonl); requests = per-window request caps (not tokens); 0 or omitted = skip that window.
_howto: 键 = 面板上看到的上游名（代理写进 api-calls.jsonl 的 provider 字段）。requests 填每个滚动窗口的「请求次数」上限，不是 token。填 0 或省略 = 不估那个窗口。
